session_notes: Strong B13 candidate. Independently names both MCR and sensitivity and uses them jointly to justify final model. Systematic graph use. Train/test with spontaneous generalization comment.

B13.quote: MCR 0'a daha yakın, sensitivity 1'e daha yakın olan modeli seçmek lazım.
B13.note: Scaffold-free; names both metrics, states direction for each, framed as decision rule. 3 CTR rows inspected before this statement. Strong B13-D2 candidate.

B2.note: Multiple threshold iterations across 3 variables; graph-driven movable value positioning documented.

B8.note: Both MCR and sensitivity used jointly in model selection before teacher input.
